name: AFR168 [襟翼、缝翼问题，起落架卡阻]

cards.audioText: N: [Your callsign is AFR168, you are inbound for Wuhan, descending passed 4800m for 3600m, call Wuhan Control to request further descent.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你的呼号是法航168，你正飞往武汉，正从4800米下到3600米，呼叫武汉区调，请求进一步下降。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR168, destination Wuhan, descending from 4800m for 3600m, request further descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，法航168，目的地武汉，正在从4800米下到3600米，请求进一步下降。

cards.audioText: C: AFR168, Wuhan Control, contact Wuhan Approach on 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C：法航168，武汉区调，联系武汉进近124.35。

cards.audioText: N: [You are leveling at 3600m, you have received ATIS J, ask Wuhan Approach which arrival is in use.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你现在正在3600米平飞，你已经收到了通播J，询问武汉进近，可用的进近程序是哪一个。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR168, leveling at 3600m, ATIS J, request arrival in use.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航168，正在3600米平飞，收到通播J，请求可用进近程序。

cards.audioText: C: AFR168, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, expect IKUBA 05A arrival, runway in use 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：法航168，武汉进近，雷达看见了，预计IKUBA 05A进近，使用跑道04。
cards.referenceText: Expect IKUBA 05A arrival, runway 04, AFR168.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计IKUBA 05A进近，跑道04，法航168。

cards.audioText: C: AFR168, descend to and maintain 2400m on QNH996.
cards.audioTextZh: C：法航168，下2400米保持，修正海压996。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 2400m on QNH996, AFR168.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下2400米保持，修正海压996，法航168。

cards.audioText: C: AFR168, reduce speed to 170kts, track direct to DA, expect your approach from the west.
cards.audioTextZh: C：法航168，减速至170节，直飞DA，预计从西边进近。
cards.referenceText: Reduce speed to 170kts, track direct to DA, expect approach from the west, AFR168.
cards.referenceTextZh: 减速至170节，直飞DA，预计从西边进近，法航168。

cards.audioText: N: [The slats on the aircraft are unable to be extended, advise controller about this situation, and request maintain speed 220kts.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你飞机上的缝翼无法放出，告知管制员此情况，请求速度保持220节。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR168, slats unable to extend, request maintain speed 220kts.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航168，缝翼无法放出，请求速度保持220节。

cards.audioText: N: [You want to hold at DA to deal with this problem, notify Wuhan Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你想在DA等待来解决这个问题，告知武汉进近。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR168, request hold at DA to solve problem.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航168，请求在DA等待来解决问题。

cards.audioText: N: [You are unable to extend most of the flaps, and the slats remain in the zero position, advise Wuhan Approach that you require a longer runway for landing due to the high approach speed.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你已经无法放出大部分襟翼，缝翼也在零位，告知管制员，由于过高的进近速度，你需要一个更长的跑道着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR168, unable to extend most of the flaps, slats remain zero position, request longer runway for landing due to high approach speed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航168，无法放出大部分襟翼，缝翼也在零位，由于过高的进近速度，申请一个更长的跑道着陆。

cards.audioText: C: AFR168, Wuhan Approach, roger, change your landing runway to 36R, advise when ready to approach.
cards.audioTextZh: C：法航168，武汉进近，收到，着陆跑道更改至36右，准备好进近时报。
cards.referenceText: change to runway 36R, wilco, AFR168.
cards.referenceTextZh: 更改至36右，将照办，法航168。

cards.audioText: N: [You are now manually flying the aircraft due to auto-pilot malfunctioned, tell the controller you are ready for approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【由于自动驾驶失效，你现在正在手动操纵制飞机，告诉管制员，你准备好进近了。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR168, we are on manual due auto-pilot malfunction, ready for approach.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航168，自动驾驶失效，正在手动操纵飞机，准备好进近了。

cards.audioText: C: AFR168, Wuhan Approach, radar vectors, after this orbit, fly heading 060.
cards.audioTextZh: C：法航168，武汉进近，雷法引导，这次盘旋后，航向060。
cards.referenceText: Radar vectors, after the orbit fly heading 060, AFR168.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷法引导，这次盘旋后，航向060，法航168。

cards.audioText: N: [Now you are 5 miles from touchdown, you have encountered wake turbulence from departing heavy aircraft, you decided to go around, call Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你现在距离接地点5海里，你遇到了前方起飞航空器导致的尾流，你决定复飞，呼叫武汉塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR168, 5 miles from touchdown, encountered wake turbulence from departing heavy aircraft, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，法航168，距离接地点5海里，遇到了前方起飞航空器导致的尾流，复飞了。

cards.audioText: C: AFR168, follow the published go around procedures, climb to 900m.
cards.audioTextZh: C：法航168，按照公布的复飞程序，上900米。
cards.referenceText: Follow published go around procedures, climb to 900m, AFR168.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按照公布的复飞程序，上900米，法航168。

cards.audioText: C: AFR168, apologies for the separation problem, contact Wuhan Approach on 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C：法航168，抱歉间隔原因，联系武汉进近124.35。

cards.audioText: N: [Your landing gear was jammed during retraction, make an urgency call to Wuhan Approach about the situation, and request another holding pattern.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【在收上起落架过程中，你的起落架卡阻了，向武汉进近做一个紧急通话，告知此情况，请求再次加入等待程序。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, AFR168, landing gear jammed during retraction, request another holding pattern.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉进近，法航168，在收上起落架过程中，起落架卡阻了，请求再次加入等待程序，

cards.audioText: C: AFR168, roger, turn left heading 250, track direct to DA, climb to and maintain 3900m.
cards.audioTextZh: C：法航168，收到，左转航向250，直飞DA，上3900米保持。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 250, track direct to DA, climb to and maintain 3900m, AFR168.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向250，直飞DA，上3900米保持，法航168。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR168, a thunderstorm will approach the airport within 30 minutes, acknowledge.
N: [Tell Wuhan Approach you will need to dumping fuel for about 10 minutes and return for an emergency landing.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：法航168，雷暴将在30分钟到达机场，请知晓。
N：【告知武汉进近，你需要放油10分钟，然后返场进行紧急着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach AFR168, request dumping fuel for 10 minutes and return for emergency landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航168，请求放油10分钟，然后返场进行紧急着陆。

cards.audioText: C: AFR168, turn left heading 330, climb to maintain 4200m, expect your fuel dump instruction shortly.
cards.audioTextZh: C：法航168，左转航向330，上4200米保持，预计一会发布放油指令。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 330, climb to maintain 4200m, roger, AFR168.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向330，上4200米保持，收到，法航168。

cards.audioText: N: [Request Wuhan Approach for emergency service on arrival and that the runway is foamed up.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【请求武汉进近，在着陆后需要紧急服务，并且需要在跑道上喷洒泡沫。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR168, request emergency service on arrival and that the runway is foamed up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航168，请求在着陆后紧急服务，并且在跑道上喷洒泡沫。
